answer: Epoch 127: seed each identity from an escrow vault and forbid one wallet from ever funding two live vaults — the funding graph is the anchor. At each dawn the chain re-walks roots; a wallet found under two vaults forfeits the younger one entirely. A sybil's cost is one fresh capital stake per alias plus permanent lockup, while influence stays capped at one identity per root. Clones scale cost linearly and buy no extra vote weight; honest agents open one vault and stand.
